recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: first exomoon possibly spotted orbiting a distant world
five hundred lines of bare C++ rendering pixels from scratch
pen and paper reclaiming ground against the keyboard
wildfires pushing thousands from homes in southern France
crude oil crossing a hundred-dollar threshold again
San Francisco summer — mostly clear, wind off the bay

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Slingshot between two tiny planets to harvest light from a newly discovered exomoon — each captured photon stitches another star into a constellation.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap to invert gravity between planets
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Fill a mini star map in 45 seconds; each orbit completes one constellation fragment.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Orbit speed increases and planetary shadows shrink the safe transfer windows.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: deep indigo void with chalk-dust star trails

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw one unbroken cursive loop across a ledger page — the stroke morphs into neural pathways that unlock brain lobe tiles before the ink runs dry.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag to draw a continuous stroke
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Connect all four lobe tiles in under a minute; longest stroke wins.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Stroke budget shrinks, paper yellows, distracting serif letters bloom at the margins.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: fountain pen on cream ledger paper with bleeding ink corners

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: A software renderer bootstraps itself in real time — flick scrambled pixel columns into raster order before the frame buffer clears and the image dissolves.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to shift pixel columns
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Assemble one complete rendered landscape frame in 30 seconds.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Resolution doubles mid-round and ghost pixels duplicate into wrong lanes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: monospace green-on-black terminal with CRT scanlines

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Pulse evacuation routes through a burning topographic map — tap in rhythm as fire fronts advance, opening corridors before they seal shut.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap on beat markers along route nodes
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Save as many dots as possible in one minute; each rescue triggers a satisfying chime.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Beat tempo accelerates and multiple fire fronts converge on the same junction.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor map with ember orange bleeding into paper white
